purpose: Phase 1C read-only creator identity reconciliation. This file authorizes identity matching only; it never authorizes a data write.

rules: This records future platform authority only; it does not create a D1 creator or authorize a child record write.
Active-table candidates require a later creator-creation decision, source-object proof, consent review, and a separately approved manifest.
Credentials, sessions, bridge material, and binary uploads remain excluded.
Display names, emails, handles, and foreign IDs are corroborating evidence only and never create a mapping.
An identity mapping is not approval to copy, update, or delete child records.
Target-only fixtures are never matched automatically.
Future canonical mappings are planning-only and never satisfy an exact source-to-target creator mapping requirement.
